children: Noah Holdings Ltd. Sponsored ADR Class A (NYSE:NOAH) reported Q2 revenue of ¥619.9M, down 1.5% YoY, with net income ¥232.2M (CNY 3.37/ADS) and adjusted EPS CNY 3.46/ADS as management pointed to lower insurance commissions and service fees while costs and credit provisions fell; the board named Tianjing Zhang independent effective Aug 29, 2026, as Cynthia Jinhong Meng retires Aug 28, 2026 and David Zhang is re‑designated independent.
Noah Holdings Revenue Slips, Adjusted EPS Beat

: NOAH Q2 revenue ¥619.9M, down 1.5% YoY. Net income ¥232.2M (CNY 3.37/ADS). Adjusted EPS CNY 3.46/ADS. Management cites lower insurance commissions and service fees; costs and credit provisions fell.
: Noah Holdings (NOAH) board changes: Tianjing Zhang named independent director effective Aug 29, 2026; Cynthia Jinhong Meng to retire Aug 28, 2026; David Zhang re-designated independent.
